Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd., located at No. 136, Qingchun Road, Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China, is a chemical enterprise engaged in the development, production, and supply of new-material and specialty chemical products. Based in Hangzhou—one of China’s most dynamic industrial and innovation hubs—the company focuses on serving downstream manufacturers with chemical solutions designed to support performance, efficiency, and product quality across a range of applications.

With an emphasis on new chemical materials, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. is oriented toward market-driven research and product improvement, aiming to deliver stable quality, reliable supply, and responsive technical service. The company’s business typically involves integrating upstream resources and collaborating with partners to provide tailored materials for industrial customers, supporting sectors such as advanced manufacturing and related processing industries. In addition to product supply, the company seeks to strengthen customer relationships through application support, logistics coordination, and ongoing communication to meet changing production needs.

Committed to responsible operations, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. continues to enhance its management systems and operational capabilities, pursuing sustainable development while adapting to evolving regulatory and environmental requirements. Through continuous innovation and a practical, customer-oriented approach, the company strives to be a dependable chemical materials partner for domestic and international clients.
